Name: Alternate Park Jaemin
Author: AndrewJamesC
Description:
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/691403399882604594/1141546754634957040/overview.png[/img]
﻿[b]An alternate version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13753]Park Jaemin's[/url] portraits and sprites.[/b] I really enjoyed the mod (And recommend it to anyone reading), I just wasn't the biggest fan of the portraits- so, I remade them! This took me a surprisingly long time to make, although I mostly just procrastinated (Only took like, 3 *real* days of work). If this is the first time you're hearing about Jaemin, again, I highly recommend it! Very cute mod.
﻿[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/691403399882604594/1141546754093887548/installation.png[/img]
﻿Exact same process as any other mod 😇!
﻿1. Download and unzip portrait mod in your mods folder.
﻿2. Enjoy! 
﻿If you see any issues, let me know! This is my first alternate portrait mod.

﻿Thank you to Baguette Magiqu for letting me make this mod, as well as the kind folks over at the Stardew Valley Discord server for helping me with my portraits.
